#ifndef HPC_PARAMS_H

#define TILE 32
#define SIMD 1
#define J_TILE 32

#define OMP_CHUNK 1
#endif

hypothesis: Enabling the contiguous-column layout and SIMD on its independent j iterations may improve vectorization and memory locality while preserving the sequential k accumulation for each output element.
notes: This is a parameter-only candidate; no commands were run and correctness or speed gains are unverified.
transformations: Set LAYOUT=1 to use the existing tiled k loop with contiguous j traversal of B and C.
Set SIMD=1 to enable SIMD across distinct output columns, preserving each column's k accumulation order.
